name: a refused create writes a notice with its content and the refusal detail
a queued update of the refused create is folded into its notice; an unrelated entry stays
a refused command folds a lap naming its predicted run, that lap's own update, and a command naming the run
a refused tag create folds a link keyed by it and a mark in another scope keyed by it
a refused board create folds every write to the scopes it would govern
a partly dependent entry loses the dependent delta and its guards and keeps the rest
a sent dependent becomes an orphan held in the notice, and its refusal ends it without a notice of its own
an orphan the server admits resolves
a sent entry only partly dependent is no orphan: its own refusal writes a notice with its full content
an edit never joins an orphan: the orphan ends without a notice, the edit ends in its own
a refused tag create in one tree folds nothing of a same-id tag or mark in another tree
